We call on the parties concerned to work for early deescalation and accumulate conditions for resuming dialogue and negotiation.

items.a: For anything specific, I’d refer you to competent authorities. The aim is to contain Japan’s remilitarization and its attempt to possess nuclear weapons.

China will do what is necessary to firmly protect their legitimate and lawful rights and interests.
